name: hergy-weblint
comment: The check the WebUI's modules get before a browser opens them: every name they use is defined or imported, and every name they define or import is read (eslint's no-undef and no-unused-vars, eslint.config.js). Pinned to exact versions (no ^ or ~). go run ./tools/check names runs it: the gate copies this file, bun.lock and eslint.config.js into .bin/weblint and installs there, since Go would read the .go files one dependency ships. To move a version, edit it here, run bun install here, keep bun.lock and delete node_modules.
